test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose "No error'.**

If I was your sister, I would have never slapped you.
solution:
The correct answer is "**If I was your**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error is a grammatical in the use of the verb.
 
• **The correct verb to use in the conditional clause is 'were' instead of 'was' because it is a hypothetical situation.**
 
• **The subject is not actually the object's sister but is stating a hypothetical situation.**
 
• 'Was' is used for past tense while 'were' is used for hypothetical situations.
 
 
• ​Example: If I were the president of India. I was watching the game yesterday.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence should be "If I were your sister, I would have never slapped you.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
